newsitem.title: BRAZIL: SOCCER-SOUTH AMERICAN SUPERCUP/CONMEBOL CUP RESULTS.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-SOUTH AMERICAN SUPERCUP/CONMEBOL CUP RESULTS.

text.p: Results of Wednesday's matches in the South American Supercup and Conmebol Cup competitions.
In Belo Horizonte, Brazil: Cruzeiro (Brazil) 3 Colo Colo (Chile) 2 (halftime 3-1)
Cruzeiro - Paulinho (12th minute), Gilmar (21st), Celio Lucio (38th)
In Uberlandia, Brazil: Santos (Brazil) 1 Velez Sarsfield (Argentina) 2 (1-1)
Velez Sarsfield - Martin Posse (12th), Jose Luis Chilavert (42nd, penalty)
Note: the Supercup is played every year between past winners of the Libertadores Cup.
In Buenos Aires: Lanus (Argentina) 3 Rosario Central (Argentina) 0 (1-0)
Scorers: Ruben da Silva (45th), Horacio Carbonari (56th), Oscar Mena (77th)
In Rio de Janeiro: Vasco da Gama (Brazil) 2 Santa Fe (Colombia) 1 (1-0)
